interface.signature: root: TreeNode, target: int, k: int -> List[int]

preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root of the tree must be a TreeNode object or None.
The target node value must be an integer between 1 and 10^4.
The distance k must be an integer between 1 and 20.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, int) and 1 <= node <= 10**4 for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the returned list must be integers between 1 and 10^4.
All elements in the returned list must be unique.
The returned list must be sorted in ascending order.
